title: Velvety Russian Mushroom Dumplings
description: A rich and creamy Russian dish featuring tender mushrooms and pillowy dumplings, perfect for a lazy Sunday, made with a sous-vide and wrapped in a lotus leaf for added flavor and presentation.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, melted butter, and eggs to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of heavy cream in the center of each disk.
Add a few slices of mushroom on top of the cream and fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape.
Place the dumplings in a single layer in a sous-vide bag and seal the bag.
Cook the dumplings in a water bath at 180 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
While the dumplings are cooking, prepare the lotus leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Wrap each dumpling in a lotus leaf and serve with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of grated cheese and chopped fresh dill.
Garnish with additional mushrooms and dill if desired.
